title: QSide CONCRETIZED AND GATED: QSide.lean pins the zero-side scale of the walk spine as a NAMED DATA FACE (the day-020 audit band); Qside IS the measured |zeta| fill resid = |zeta(1/2+it) - K_on(t)| under the A4.3 wiring; four LEAN-PROVEN gates (112.6x squeeze gap, 206x Xval headroom, route-A resid<dev, 48x def-dominates-fill) + Float #eval cross-checks; full build 17450 green
body: THE MOVE: the Qside contract of the walk spine (discovery 0088 - ONE concrete zero-side scale Qside in both the S1 leg hs1Q (Qside >= devOf - Mf) and the S3 leg hs3Q (Qside <= Bwire + Mr)) is now CONCRETIZED as a named data face in formal/RhAttack/QSide.lean.  WHAT Qside IS: the measured |zeta| fill resid(t) = |zeta(1/2 + i t) - K_on(t)|, the section-10 LHS (A0 same-object: identically |W_n - (K_on - (P_n - I))|) - the |zeta| fill under the definition-side kernel K_on, measured on the line at scan height t straddling the candidate pair height g (window [g-12, g+12], d-grid with d_min = 1/200).  At the same points the day-020 record carries the kernel deviation dev(t) = |K_on(t)| * min_d |R(g,d,t) - 1|, whose ratio dev/resid is the audit MARGIN.  The A4.3-wired definition side (the S3 leg's bound) is the Xval pin (b3BoundExplicit RHS = xvalPin), which dominates the model residual |x| = xPin there with 206x headroom.  SOURCE RECORDS: scripts/rh/day020_worstcase.py -> out_day020_worstcase.txt (4 candidate pairs = nearest on-line zeros to 980/1000/1020/1040; overall worst margin 112.6 at t = 1006.7916 with resid = 0.08168, dev = 9.198; 'route-A pointwise decision resid < dev: HOLDS on the scanned windows') and scripts/rh/day020_xval_pin.py -> out_day020_xval_pin.txt (Xval pin at t = 1000.041572, band (2000.083144, 1e5]: |x| = 0.019253844165493 <= Xval = 3.9665418656908, headroom 206.013).  THE MODULE (QSide.lean, GATED): Part A pins the exact record decimals as defs (g1-g4, windowHalf = 12, dMin = 0.005, tWorst/residWorst/devWorst/marginWorst, tXval/xPin/xvalPin/headroom) + the inAuditBand predicate + worstInBand (the closing point is in the band - norm_num).  Part B is the LEAN-PROVEN exact-rational gates (C7-style, printed decimals are exact rationals): gate_worst_margin (devWorst >= 112.6 * residWorst - the 112.6x squeeze gap), gate_xval_headroom (xvalPin >= 206 * xPin - the |x| <= Xval pin PASS), gate_resid_below_dev (0 < residWorst < devWorst - route-A at the closing point), gate_def_dominates_fill (48 * residWorst <= xvalPin - the A4.3-wired bound exceeds the band's worst fill, the hDef direction).  Part C is the Float #eval-readable cross-checks (per the pinned convention: gates must be Float literals + Float arithmetic): 9.198/0.08168 -> 112.610186, 3.9665418656908/0.019253844165493 -> 206.012983, 3.9665418656908/0.08168 -> 48.561972.  Part D names the face (qsideWorst, devSideWorst, bwireXval) and bundles it in qsideFaceGated (the four gated facts as one statement).  HONESTY: MEASURED (resid/dev/|x| are day-020 mpmath measurements, carried as named data, never re-derived), PINNED (the Xval side), LEAN-PROVEN (the gates).  Per-pair rounded values are deliberately NOT re-gated (the C7 4-significant-figure print-precision note).  RELATION TO THE WALK SPINE: the audit-point margin package (hZero/hDef/hStrict) is formalized in Closure.lean C6 (p9_audited_package_strict, p9_closure_at_audit_point) over the spec c6-margin-wire-abstract.md; QSide.lean supplies the gated DATA that package measures and does NOT re-state the C6 letter mapping (that stays Closure.lean's job).  The band-level UNIFORM extension of the face beyond the scanned window is a named open item, not a claim here.  NO RH claim: this pins and gates a data face; it changes nothing about the named residual of the endpoint, and it makes hs1/hs3 checkable data faces (not bare parameters) at the audited band.  Next formal move: hook the QSide face into the low-band leg (hS2low / hs1 at the audited band) as the checkable instance of the walk spine.  ALSO (data, in flight): the s31z2 5e8G ladder - dps-15 landed (logzeta = +2.9370199551, peak 92.6 GB), dps-20 landed (logzeta = +1.7289704098, peak 92.6 GB); the dps-30 cross is running now; dps-40 (the census working channel) is last.  The dps15/dps20 logzeta spread (~1.2 in log|zeta|, a |zeta| factor ~3.3) at ONE height is itself a datum: log|zeta| at 1.5e19 is precision-sensitive at the dps-15 level (cancellation in the N = 1.55e9-term sum eats digits), which is why the 5e8G row certifies only at dps-40 on this protocol.
